title: Needs
description: Needs per tier (CONTENT §2, §11, MECHANICS §6.2). A need is either a goods need (a category with acceptable goods) or a building need (building + radius). Every acceptable good and every building need has a share (D-056): category coverage = min(1, sum of the shares of the supplied alternatives x their supply ratio). The share is optional: when absent the loader uses 1.0 for a lone alternative and 0.6 for each of two or more; an authored share wins. kind: required needs count toward satisfaction; optional needs are shown but have no effect (the optional tax bonus was removed by D-056). name is the player-facing name (1–32 printable characters; display data only); a goods need's category must be listed in need_categories.json.

share.description: Coverage contributed by this alternative at full supply (D-056; default 1.0 for a lone alternative, 0.6 otherwise).
